answer: Novartis aims to be net zero by 2040. From a 2022 base year it targets a 90% absolute reduction in Scope 1 and 2 by 2030, maintained through 2040, and Scope 3 reductions of 42% by 2030 and 90% by 2040. The near-term Scope 3 focus covers purchased goods and services, upstream transportation and distribution, business travel and employee commuting. SBTi validated the targets in 2024. Residual emissions that cannot be avoided or eliminated are neutralized with carbon removal credits. In 2025, combined Scope 1 and 2 fell 14% year-on-year and 45% from 2022, Scope 3 fell 4% year-on-year and 17% from 2022, and all scopes fell 19% from 2022.
